title: FactDef
description: K'UHUL semantic fact contract. @kind must be semantic.fact.v1. @epistemic_status 'Verified' cannot be self-declared at ingestion — Verified is earned through the validation policy. JSON schema validates structure; predicate declaration is validated by RelationRegistry.validate_usage() at parse time (live registry check, not JSON schema).

@subject_type.description: Subject entity type, validated against the relation's declared domain. Absent = wildcard (type check skipped at parse time). This bridge behavior is temporary pending entity-type resolution from the graph.

@predicate.description: Relation id. Must be declared in RelationRegistry. JSON schema validates that this is a string; RelationRegistry.validate_usage() validates that it is declared.

@object.description: Object entity identifier, value, or name.

@object_type.description: Object entity type, validated against the relation's declared range. Absent = wildcard.

@epistemic_status.description: Entry-state epistemic status accepted at ingestion. Verified, Inferred, and Disputed are earned by the engine and cannot be self-declared in a fact contract. Pattern Induction Guard: parse() rejects 'Verified' with std::runtime_error.

@provenance.description: Evidence sources: micronaut ids, document references, capability names.

@authority.description: Fact evidence authority. This is NOT the relation schema authority; it describes who vouches for this specific proposition.
